report:
Assessed the current complete production_execution claim, all six ordinary implementation associations and all four ordinary test associations after a fresh start. No TODO/N/A evidence is present. This is a source assessment; root owns current suite execution, and I did not rerun tests during this refresh.

Production routing: compile/mod.rs materializes the inline sources and generated standalone Cargo manifest, invokes SageHost::try_open, then observe::collect. driver.rs uses metadata::load_workspace, a production Database with the real metadata proxy, source registration and setup_root_module/parse_str_to_cst. metadata.rs obtains Cargo target information and the pinned sysroot, skips compiling the selected fixture when it has no Cargo dependencies, and supplies real metadata rather than expectations. The generated inline manifest currently has no third-party dependencies, so the standard library is its external metadata source. parse/exprs.rs constructs CST expressions from actual syntax; it never accepts expected answers. observe.rs forces expanded module items, function signatures and checked bodies, collects their real diagnostics and uses the resulting typed trees for observations. This establishes production-path reuse, not universal support for every Rust construct.

Inputs versus outputs: prepare uses only the presence of observation/diagnostic/query expectations to control required output and capture, never their text. collect receives source markers and a query-capture boolean, derives types from checked bodies, diagnostics from production results and query logs from actual inspection events. run applies expect.assert_eq only after prepare succeeds. completed_types_ignore_expected_text_and_use_later_constraints provides contradictory invented bool/u64 expectation texts for identical source; it asserts identical u16 observations, reflecting the later return constraint, and empty diagnostics. That test exercises the semantic independence boundary; source inspection confirms the same boundary excludes diagnostic and query expectation text.

Negative Rust fixtures and separate conformance: invalid_source_reaches_sage supplies true in a u16-returning body and asserts the precise Sage mismatch rendering/location. driver.rs constructs a separate extern-only metadata stub rather than passing that body to the embedded compiler; metadata.rs does not compile the dependency-free selected fixture. compile/mod.rs saves the result of independent rustc::check and still executes Sage before combining results. compile/rustc.rs executes the real fixture separately with the pinned compiler, parses its diagnostics and validates exit status; the current execute/validate_output helper split preserves that separation. Therefore metadata-provider success is not mistaken for conformance, and a rustc-invalid fixture reaches Sage.

Failure classification: unknown_edition_fails_setup asserts a direct preparation error for invalid configuration. failed_metadata_provider_replacement_preserves_the_live_host injects an invalid compiler option into the same try_open_with_args initialization path and asserts a metadata-provider error plus preservation and usability of the old host. The fixture manifest and source were captured with review read. The provider readiness channel carries Result independently of source diagnostics; failed startup/expansion and disconnected readiness are returned as errors. CompileTest propagates host setup errors before invoking observation and source-marker matching. run panics on preparation errors before expectations can accept or update them. The current independent rustc execute helper likewise returns spawn errors directly, and validate_output rejects malformed/abnormal output before source matching.

All requirements and qualifications are accounted for by the current implementation and visible assertions. No source changes were made in this refresh and no edits are requested.
